q: Lebesgue's Dominated Convergence Theorem says that if fₙ → f a.e. and |fₙ| ≤ g with g integrable, then:
opts: The fₙ are uniformly integrable but convergence of integrals may fail
exp: DCT: pointwise a.e. convergence plus a dominating integrable bound guarantees ∫fₙ dμ → ∫f dμ. This is the workhorse of analysis.
